# HUB v3.0.3 for Windows

Windows package: `HUB-v3.0.3-release.zip`

- **In-app updates:** check, download, and install verified updates without signing in. HUB restarts after you confirm installation and keeps your settings and history.
- **Stable notifications:** the short `Updates` button turns blue only for newer Stable releases. Automatic checks run shortly after startup and every 15 minutes. Beta updates are available only through a manual check inside Updates.
- **Cleaner updater:** theme-matched controls, release notes before installation, update history, and what's new after an updater restart. Test is now called Beta.
- **Spine CC Packer:** optional `Direct 3.8 to 3.6` conversion, using each existing target's supported legacy format. Preview checks compatibility before packing; original exports stay unchanged. Progress follows the actual work. Unsupported features are blocked, not silently discarded; verify converted animations in your game's runtime.
- **Sequence Browser:** removes long explanatory text while retaining its existing filters, caching, previews, and shortcuts.

## Download and update

Extract the ZIP and run `HUB/HUB.exe`, or use the included installer. Keep the complete HUB folder together. Users on v3.0.2 or older need this ZIP once to obtain the updater. Existing updater-enabled Test builds and the local Beta build can update directly to stable v3.0.3; no Beta compatibility bridge is needed for this stable release.

The original HUB repository keeps the full Windows download. The no-login updater uses the existing public downloads-only repository; source code stays private. Downloading does not install automatically: choose `Install & restart` when ready. HUB blocks installation while an editing job is active and verifies package signatures and file hashes.

## macOS

Windows-only release. The [v3.0.1 Apple Silicon Mac preview](https://github.com/midas-soft/sigma-helper-hub/releases/tag/v3.0.1) remains unchanged.
